title: Nervous system: overview anatomy
description: One continuous network: the brain and spinal cord compute, and 43 pairs of peripheral nerves carry orders out and reports back.

questions.question: What are the main divisions of the nervous system?
questions.answer: The central nervous system consists of brain and spinal cord. Peripheral nerves and ganglia connect it to the rest of the body; autonomic circuits regulate many involuntary functions.

questions.question: How do nerves carry information between the body and brain?
questions.answer: Sensory pathways bring information toward the central nervous system, and motor pathways send commands outward. Spinal and cranial nerves also support reflexes and organ control.

questions.question: What is the brain?
questions.answer: Cerebrum, cerebellum and brainstem inside the cranial vault. Function: Integration, consciousness, motor planning and autonomic control.

questions.question: Where is the brainstem located?
questions.answer: Midbrain, pons and medulla connecting cord to brain. Function: Vital centres: respiration, heart rate, consciousness.

questions.question: What is the function of the cervical plexus?
questions.answer: Function: Neck muscles and skin; phrenic nerve to diaphragm. Nerve network in the posterior triangle of the neck.
